species.name: Curlop
species.summary: An upright crescent of dense fur: a round head end, a cream belly, two stout hind feet, a long curled tail, and two small three-fingered hands held together at the chest (a free front pair over a contact hind pair).

taxonomy.resembles: an upright crescent with a curled tail and small hands
taxonomy.ability: draft: to be set by the game designer

signature.feature: a curled tail and two small three-fingered hands held at the chest; the fiddlehead of the ferns
